scope: Provenance research for Tiny Core Linux 4.7.2 baseline; no distro binary downloaded, unpacked, or executed.

local_evidence.observation: Extracted module tree identifies kernel release 3.0.21-tinycore.
Cpio manifest is the source of current extracted-rootfs paths and hashes.

authoritative_sources.kind: official Tiny Core Linux forum; administrator notice
authoritative_sources.evidence: Administrator Curaga announced 4.x repository removal at end of 2024 (2024-10-17) and confirmed "4.x has been removed" on 2025-01-03.
authoritative_sources.use: Explains why historical 4.x directory paths are no longer available.

authoritative_sources.kind: official Tiny Core documentation hosted at project mirror
authoritative_sources.evidence: Documents the 4.x release/distribution_files layout and names core.gz and vmlinuz as separate base files.
authoritative_sources.use: Authoritative historical layout guidance; not a checksum or 4.7.2 byte source.

authoritative_sources.evidence: Current archive listing covers 5.x onward; historical 4.x is absent, consistent with its announced removal.

authoritative_sources.kind: official Tiny Core Linux forum; contemporaneous 4.7.2 user report
authoritative_sources.evidence: Post dated 2012-12-27 describes using the 4.7.2 vmlinuz/core.gz pair.
authoritative_sources.use: Corroborates that 4.7.2 used the normal kernel/initrd filenames; not an official checksum.

authoritative_sources.kind: official Tiny Core Linux forum; contemporaneous kernel discussion
authoritative_sources.evidence: Post dated 2012-11-11 reports uname output `3.0.21-tinycore #3021`; reply states it is the stock Linux 3.0 kernel and points to the project source files.
authoritative_sources.use: Corroborates historical kernel naming/build context; does not authenticate this ISO kernel bytes.

authoritative_sources.evidence: Tiny Core forum participant DHeadshot says they placed a 4.x zip on Internet Archive after the administrator announced removal.
authoritative_sources.use: A nonofficial mirror lead only. It was not downloaded or treated as authenticated baseline.

checksums.authenticated_iso_sha256_or_sha1: not found in located primary sources
checksums.authenticated_4.7.2_core_gz_or_vmlinuz_c: not found in located primary sources
checksums.current_official_checksum_practice: The official current distribution_files indexes publish adjacent .md5.txt files, but that does not supply a historical 4.7.2 digest.

comparison.reason: No authenticated 4.7.2 bytes or project-published checksum were reachable. The Internet Archive lead is a participant-provided archive rather than an authenticated official artifact; downloading it would not establish provenance.

network_observations.shell: Invoke-WebRequest HEAD to historical tinycorelinux.net and repo.tinycorelinux.net URLs failed DNS resolution (No such host is known).
network_observations.web: Official Tiny Core forum pages were accessible; official 4.x directory endpoints were inaccessible or returned 404.
network_observations.actions: No binary was downloaded. No sandbox/network escalation was requested.

caveats: Forum posts from users are contemporaneous community evidence, not vendor-authenticated checksums.
The released Tiny Core base identifies the OS family/version and expected components; a matching version string alone does not prove byte-for-byte identity.
No inference about intentional file modifications should be made by comparing against a substitute version such as 4.7.7.
